D: A Broadway dancer bets he can turn an unknown chorus girl into a star by the next Easter Parade.
P: Serve the sweets when the Easter Parade fills Fifth Avenue.
S: Cos and butter lettuce, anchovy parmesan dressing, egg, croutons

Crisp cos and butter lettuce tossed at the table with a creamy anchovy and parmesan dressing, garlic croutons and soft-boiled eggs. Tear 1 bread roll into chunks, toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1 crushed garlic clove and bake at 190C for 10 minutes. Cook 4 eggs for 7 minutes, cool and halve. Mash 4 anchovies with 1 garlic clove, then whisk in 1 tsp Dijon, the juice of 1 lemon, 4 tbsp mayonnaise and 30g grated parmesan. Tear 1 cos and 1 butter lettuce into a big bowl, toss with the dressing and croutons and top with the eggs and more parmesan.
Light choux puffs with gruyère and Dijon

Warm, airy French cheese puffs made with gruyère and a little mustard and cayenne, served straight from the oven. Bring 250ml water, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball and cook 1 minute. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 120g grated gruyère, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe 24 small mounds on lined trays, sprinkle with more gruyère and bake at 200C for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: Easter Sunday roast lamb with mint sauce
Garlic rosemary roast lamb leg, roast potatoes, peas, mint sauce

Garlic and rosemary studded roast leg of lamb with crunchy roast potatoes, peas with butter and a sharp fresh mint sauce. Make small cuts all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers of 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with oil and salt and roast at 190C for 1 hour 30 minutes for medium. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1.2kg parboiled potatoes in oil alongside. For mint sauce, chop a bunch of mint with 1 tbsp sugar, add 3 tbsp boiling water and 4 tbsp malt vinegar. Serve with 300g buttered peas.
Couple of Swells chicken à la King
breast, mushrooms and capsicum in sherry cream, puff shells, buttered peas, eaten in tramp costume

Chicken, mushrooms and capsicum in a sherry cream sauce, spooned into puff pastry shells with buttered peas. Dice the chicken and cook in half the butter for 6 minutes. Lift out. Fry the sliced mushrooms and diced capsicum in the rest of the butter for 5 minutes, then stir in the flour. Whisk in the stock, cream and sherry and simmer for 5 minutes. Put the chicken back, take off the heat and stir in the egg yolk. Warm the pastry cases at 180C for 5 minutes. Cook the peas for 3 minutes. Spoon the chicken into the cases, scatter with parsley and serve with the peas.
W: Hot cross bun bread and butter pudding
Hot cross buns in custard, the chocolate egg ending

Buttered hot cross buns baked in a rich vanilla custard with orange zest until puffed, then glazed with warm apricot jam. Butter 6 halved hot cross buns and layer them in a baking dish. Whisk 3 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 orange and pour over. Stand 15 minutes. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes until golden and just set. Warm 3 tbsp apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over the top. Serve warm with cream.
K: Pink cranberry grapefruit punch, for a peach (or a lemon)

Cranberry, pink grapefruit and strawberry punch topped with sparkling wine, with lemonade for anyone not drinking, served with floating berries. In a punch bowl, mix 500ml cranberry juice, 300ml pink grapefruit juice and 200g sliced strawberries and chill 30 minutes. Add plenty of ice. For the adults, top glasses with sparkling wine. For everyone else, top with lemonade. Garnish each glass with a strawberry on the rim.

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil whole for 8 minutes and drain well.
Cut small slits all over and push in slivers of garlic and rosemary sprigs. Rub with half the oil, melted butter and salt.
Peel the potatoes and parboil them.
Roast the cauliflowers and the potatoes in the rest of the oil at 200C until deep golden.
For mint sauce, chop the mint with the sugar, add a splash of boiling water and the malt vinegar.
Toss the peas in the rest of the butter and serve alongside.
